{{Recipe summary
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dried, mixed herbs
* 2 fresh [[Cookbook:Sage|sage]] leaves, finely chopped
* 4 slices of white [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] (just slightly stale is best)
* 1 clove of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 tbsp water

==Procedure==
#Trim crusts off bread and place slices into a large mixing bowl.
#Add water and all other ingredients, and with the hands, work the mixture until it is thoroughly combined.
#The stuffing may be cooked by packing it into the washed cavity of chicken or turkey, prior to roasting, or by forming the stuffing into patties and placing on a greased tray in an oven (moderate temperature).

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* For turkey stuffing, triple the above recipe.
